title: Library Management
summary: Members borrow and return books; copies, reservations and fines.
problem: Design a library system where members borrow copies of books, return them, reserve titles that are out, and pay fines for late returns.
functional: Search books by title, author or subject
Borrow and return a copy; a member has a loan limit
Reserve a title that has no free copy; notify when one returns
Charge a fine for a late return
nonFunctional: Separate a book (the title) from a copy (the physical item)
Fine rules and notification channels must be replaceable
deliverables: A class diagram (Mermaid or an uploaded image) with the relationships between classes
The responsibility of each class in a sentence
The design patterns you used and where, or why you used none
Optional: code for the central class and one method of each
hints: A "Book" and a "BookCopy" are different things: reservations attach to the title, loans to the copy.
Notifications are a natural fit for the observer pattern.
